scope: Independently scheduled CPU/GPU coordinating helpers, with typed parameter packets, owned resumable child frames and nested task trees.

semantics.planning: Selected root and reachable resumable children share one typed continuation planner. Each function entry is planned once, preserving function IDs; recursive child cycles are rejected.
semantics.calls: Direct coordinating calls retain expansion. Spawned coordinators require CPU placement and may submit explicit GPU kernels; GPU-only placement still requires a numeric kernel.
semantics.captures: Construction retains immutable host tensor leases, copies scalars and owns a directory string before the submitting packet disappears. Aliased captures keep the same immutable backing.
semantics.shapes: Declared fixed parameter dimensions are validated by the child. Dynamic operation guards stay at the original operation inside its control/error scope rather than being hoisted past catch.
semantics.results: Scalar and host Buffer results use existing ValueLayouts, publish after owned scope/external settlement and can outlive frame retirement through repeated immutable observations.
semantics.scheduler: Existing bounded scheduler and CPU/Metal runtime implementations are unchanged. Child waits suspend rather than block workers; single-worker nested progress remains qualified.
semantics.cancellation: Parent cancellation reaches descendants and external GPU completions. A deadline group retains DeadlineExceeded while descendants report cancellation. Independent invocations stay isolated.
semantics.limits: Existing depth, record and retained-frame limits apply to nested coordinators. Signatures remain float32 scalars and rank-one/rank-two float32 tensors; no task/selector/resident result escape.

coverage: two levels of resumable children plus CPU/GPU children
result ownership after child frame retirement
held GPU completions during parent cancellation/deadline and completion failure
settled parent recovery of child shape fault
dynamic shape recovery within child scope
standalone and emitted child plans match
transactional GPU coordinator, recursive/mutual child, resident escape and unobserved child diagnostics

distributed_execution: Not implemented; design-review gate retained in docs/roadmap.md.
performance: Execution composition/correctness increment; no speedup claim.
